## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3: implementation-plan Step 6 (Gap Analysis) re-dispatches dso:task-decomposer with mode: remediation when gap-analysis opus sub-agent findings target existing tasks
- dd-4: remediation_context payload includes gap-analysis artifact path and gap-analysis findings

## Testing Mode
RED (bundled: create test fixture + edit SKILL.md Step 6 in same task — Gate 2 requires both)

## Files to Modify
- tests/scripts/test-implementation-plan-step6-remediation.sh (Create — RED test fixture)
- plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md (Edit — add Remediation Re-dispatch subsection to Step 6)

## Acceptance Criteria
1. tests/scripts/test-implementation-plan-step6-remediation.sh exists and is executable
2. Test file asserts presence of Remediation Re-dispatch subsection in Step 6 section of SKILL.md using awk-scoped extraction (awk '/^## Step 6/,/^## Step [7-9]\|^$/')
3. Test asserts: trigger condition block present (grep -q 'gap-anal.*findings\|findings.*gap-anal\|REMEDIATION_DISPATCH\|remediation re-dispatch' within scoped section)
4. Test asserts: dso:task-decomposer re-dispatch present (grep -q 'task-decomposer' within scoped section)
5. Test asserts: model: "opus" literal present within scoped section
6. Test asserts: remediation_context with gap-analysis artifact path present (grep -q 'gap.analysis\|gap_analysis' within scoped section)
7. Test asserts: delta-mode preservation clause present within scoped section
8. Test asserts: SC5 single-comment instruction present within scoped section
9. SKILL.md Step 6 section contains Remediation Re-dispatch subsection with all required elements
10. Run: bash tests/scripts/test-implementation-plan-step6-remediation.sh → all assertions PASS
